news.title: Catcha Digital Q3 FY2026: Record Adjusted PATAMI RM8.31 million, Up 98% YoY

recent_en: Catcha Digital announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 25 November 2026, with a news headline reporting adjusted PATAMI of RM8.31 million, up 98% YoY. Group CEO Eric Tan Leong Yit acquired shares in the open market multiple times between August and November 2026.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026; news headline reported adjusted PATAMI of RM8.31 million, up 98% YoY.
Group CEO Eric Tan Leong Yit acquired shares multiple times between August and November 2026.
